name: Germination of Resolve

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

text:
Frequency once per day

---
Vitality floods your trammeled soul, offering you rejuvenation, if not quite rest. For each effect that causes the Enfeebled or Fatigued conditions to affect you, attempt a Nature check check to counteract that effect. The counteract rank of Germination of Resolve is equal to half your level rounded up.
